notes.title: Super Neptunia™ RPG NOW AVAILABLE on Steam!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32763017/862f166d627fa6cc059be7fb1f4c1e0db67aef45.png

Hop into Gamindustri's 2D world today! Super Neptunia™ RPG is NOW AVAILABLE on Steam® with a WEEKLONG 20% discount! The Steam version also includes English, French, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese subtitles.

Steam users can purchase the game for 20% off ($39.99) for the first week of launch! There is also a Deluxe Bundle (Game + Deluxe Pack) priced at a permanent 10% discount.

The Deluxe Pack will have its own weeklong 20% launch discount and includes:


 Character Art Collection 
 Background Art Collection 
 Rough Art Collection 
 PC Wallpapers (x2) 
 Mobile Wallpapers (x5)
 Official Soundtrack


On top of the launch of Super Neptunia RPG, there are 8 DLC available for purchase ($0.99 each) listed below (Additional DLC will be announced at a later date):


 Dengeki Bracelet Set
 Dengeki Accessory Set
 Famitsu Weapon Set
 Enchanted Weapon Set
 [Cosplay Series] Equipment Set
 [Foreign Series] Equipment Set
 [Traditional Series] Equipment Set
 [Enchanted Series] Equipment Set


The Steam and Nintendo Switch version will contain all original CGs. The PS4™ release will have two slightly modified CGs. Gameplay for all platforms has not been changed from the original Japanese release.
